title: Domain hosted on Google Cloud Platform IP 34.76.215.208
description: Apex domain resolves to 34.76.215.208, a Google Cloud Platform (GCP) IP in europe-west region.
risks: GCP misconfig could expose metadata API or cloud bucket if SSRF found.
attack_vectors: SSRF to 169.254.169.254 metadata, enumerate GCP project info, cloud bucket discovery.
proof_of_existence: playtunisie.com. 430 IN A 34.76.215.208 — IP in GCP range (34.0.0.0/8)
remediation: Restrict metadata API access, implement IMDSv2 equivalent, review IAM.

title: Mail server on separate hosting IP (193.203.239.21)
description: mail.playtunisie.com resolves to 193.203.239.21 (LWS Hosting), separate from web server.
risks: Mail server on shared hosting — potential for email spoofing, relay abuse, info leak.
attack_vectors: SMTP banner grab, test open relay, enumerate mail accounts, SMTP AUTH brute force.
proof_of_existence: mail.playtunisie.com. 6732 IN A 193.203.239.21 — MX record: playtunisie.com. MX 10 mail.playtunisie.com.
remediation: Restrict SMTP access, enforce SMTP AUTH, disable open relay, monitor logs.

title: Conflicting SPF records — two separate SPF TXT entries
description: Two SPF TXT records exist: one includes servers.etarget-emailing.com (~all), another uses mx/a records (-all). RFC requires single SPF.
risks: Email authentication ambiguity — attackers can spoof from either permitted source. Deliverability issues.
attack_vectors: Spoof emails from servers.etarget-emailing.com or mail.playtunisie.com or mailphp.lws-hosting.com.
poc: dig playtunisie.com TXT returns two v=spf1 records
proof_of_existence: TXT1: v=spf1 mx:playtunisie.com a:mail.playtunisie.com a:mailphp.lws-hosting.com -all | TXT2: v=spf1 include:servers.etarget-emailing.com ~all
remediation: Merge into single SPF record with strict -all and remove redundant entry.

title: No DNSSEC configured — DNSKEY query returns SERVFAIL
description: DNSKEY query returned SERVFAIL, indicating DNSSEC is not configured for the domain.
risks: DNS responses can be spoofed or cache-poisoned without cryptographic verification.
attack_vectors: DNS cache poisoning, response spoofing, man-in-the-middle on DNS resolution.
poc: dig playtunisie.com DNSKEY -> status: SERVFAIL, ANSWER: 0
proof_of_existence: dig playtunisie.com DNSKEY -> status: SERVFAIL, id: 36882, ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 0
remediation: Enable DNSSEC signing at LWS Hosting DNS provider.

title: No CAA records — unrestricted CA certificate issuance
description: No CAA records found. Any certificate authority can issue TLS certificates for the domain.
risks: Rogue CA or compromised CA could issue fraudulent certificates for domain spoofing.
attack_vectors: Request TLS certificate from any CA without restriction; MITM with rogue cert.
poc: dig playtunisie.com CAA -> ANSWER: 0 (no CAA records)
proof_of_existence: dig playtunisie.com CAA -> ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1 (SOA only)
remediation: Add CAA records restricting issuance to specific CAs (e.g., Let's Encrypt).

title: DNS infrastructure managed by LWS Hosting (ns9-12.lwsdns.com)
description: 4 nameservers: ns9, ns10, ns11, ns12.lwsdns.com — all under LWS Hosting provider.
risks: Single DNS provider — compromise of LWS DNS = full DNS hijack.
attack_vectors: Zone transfer attempts on lwsdns.com nameservers, social engineering LWS.
proof_of_existence: NS: ns9.lwsdns.com, ns10.lwsdns.com, ns11.lwsdns.com, ns12.lwsdns.com | SOA: ns9.lwsdns.com hostmaster.playtunisie.com
remediation: Consider multi-provider DNS or at minimum restrict zone transfers.

title: Zone transfer attempt failed — ns1.playtunisie.com not found
description: AXFR attempt against ns1.playtunisie.com failed — host not found. No self-hosted NS.
risks: No risk — zone transfer not possible via this vector.
attack_vectors: Attempt AXFR against actual LWS nameservers (ns9-12.lwsdns.com).
proof_of_existence: dig: couldn't get address for 'ns1.playtunisie.com': not found (exit code 1)
remediation: Verify AXFR is disabled on all LWS nameservers.

title: www subdomain is CNAME to apex domain
description: www.playtunisie.com is a CNAME pointing to playtunisie.com (same IP 34.76.215.208).
attack_vectors: Same attack surface as apex domain.

title: Common subdomain brute — dev, staging, test, api, admin, vpn all NXDOMAIN
description: Brute for dev/staging/test/api/admin/vpn — all returned NXDOMAIN. 44 more commands truncated.
risks: Subdomains may exist on non-standard names; crt.sh and passive DNS needed for comprehensive enum.
attack_vectors: Continue with crt.sh, SecurityTrails, passiveDNS, larger wordlist brute.
proof_of_existence: dev/staging/test/api/admin/vpn.playtunisie.com all returned NXDOMAIN with SOA in AUTHORITY section
remediation: Ensure any future subdomains use restrictive access controls.

title: No IPv6 (AAAA) support — no AAAA record configured
description: AAAA query returned no answer, only SOA in authority. No IPv6 connectivity available.
risks: No direct risk — may limit future scalability and IPv6-only client access.
attack_vectors: No IPv6 attack surface from DNS perspective.
proof_of_existence: dig playtunisie.com AAAA -> ANSWER: 0, AUTHORITY: 1 (SOA ns9.lwsdns.com)
remediation: Consider adding AAAA records for IPv6 support.
